cn.t: Critics are divided on this conspiracy thriller, with many finding Torben Betts' script clumsy and indulgent despite Janie Dee's strong central performance and Trevor Nunn's direction. The play's exploration of JFK and Monroe theories proves more frustrating than compelling.
